image_prompt: Draw a clean left-to-right flowchart for the RideIQ 'Rider segments' feature. Show input fields entering a box of ML models running in parallel, their outputs combined into a single result, then returned to the Android app as JSON. Flat modern style, rounded boxes, labeled arrows. A standardize box feeding PCA (2D scatter of 3 rider groups) and LDA (separation histogram).
